verdicts.explanation: The paper's introduction attributes σion ≈ 10−10–10−9 S.cm−1 at 100 °C for microcrystalline Li2O2 to Gerbig et al. (ref. 9), so literature_cited is correct and the value, unit, temperature and null secondary fields all match.

The paper says Dunst et al. (ref. 20) reported the overall conductivity of the microcrystalline reference sample as 3.4x10−13 S.cm−1; this is a cited value, and the paper gives no measurement temperature, so null is correct.

The paper attributes the increase to 1.1x10−10 S.cm−1 after ball-milling to Dunst et al. (ref. 20), a literature value, and gives no measurement temperature, so the null temperature and the ball-milling synthesis method are correct.
